style: North Indian Nagara sanctuary in the living Alopibagh precinct
key_structures: Rose street arch with the Shakti Peetha name in Hindi and Tamil
Covered forecourt leading to the inner entrance and paired lion sculptures
Flat-roofed ranges around the tall tapered, panelled shikhara
Silver-clad cradle over the sacred kund
special_features: Devotees revere Alopi Shankari in the form of a covered wooden cradle
The temple occupies an urban compound in Alopibagh. The Triveni Sangam is a separate pilgrimage site
period: Historic sacred site with a living modern compound
renovation_history: The game models the photographed approach and recent darshan arrangement. The dimensions and construction dates of individual ranges have not been surveyed.
